message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.1.5 IS LIVE! (PREMIERE PRO)**[cite: 6]

A focused timeline precision update introducing one-click J-Cut & L-Cut audio split edits, alongside a unified and responsive General Tab redesign[cite: 6].

*(Install with your ZXP installer and restart Premiere Pro once to load the update[cite: 6].)*

♦️ **New One-Click J-Cut & L-Cut (General ▸ Timeline)**
* **Instant Split Edits:** Select a clip and click J-CUT to start audio before the picture, or L-CUT to extend audio past the picture, without altering video sync[cite: 6].
* **Neighboring Audio Trimming:** Automatically trims adjacent audio clips to accommodate the overlap based on your configurable CUT LENGTH (12 frames by default)[cite: 6].
* **Track Protection & Automatic Rollback:** Locked tracks are preserved and identified in the status readout[cite: 6]. If Premiere fails to place the edit with exact precision, the operation automatically rolls back[cite: 6].

♦️ **Rebuilt Unified General Tab**
* **Single-View Card Layout:** Eliminated the tab switch—everything is now visible in structured cards (Actions, Transform, Timeline, Nest & Freeze, Quality Check, Quick Effects)[cite: 6].
* **In-Tab Transform Controls:** Transform properties (Anchor Point, Position, Scale, Rotation, Opacity, Reset) are integrated directly beneath primary action buttons with explicit NO SELECTION states[cite: 6].
* **Clear Unit Labeling:** All input fields clearly indicate their measurement unit (STEP DELAY (sec), CUT LENGTH (frames), FREEZE HOLD (sec), FLASH UNDER (frames))[cite: 6].
* **Adaptive Scaling:** The interface retains its layout at any panel width, including narrow default docks, with non-functional keyframe buttons removed[cite: 6].

♦️ **UI Fixes**
* **Clean UI:** Eliminated the red ResizeObserver loop limit exceeded notice box[cite: 6].
